recentItems.title: Tempest Rising - Official ‘The Veti’s Wrath’ Expansion Release Date Trailer
recentItems.description: Here's a look at ‘The Veti’s Wrath’ Expansion Release Date Trailer for Tempest Rising, a real-time strategy game developed by Slipgate Ironworks. Players can get a new look at the upcoming expansion that brings 11 new missions from the perspective of the Veti, a powerful and technologically advanced faction established in previous instances in the game. Take on ‘The Veti’s Wrath’ Expansion in Tempest Rising on September 29 for PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Blackwood - Official Game Overview Trailer
recentItems.description: Take a look at the Game Overview Trailer for Blackwood, a third-person action-adventure game developed by AttritoM7 Productions. Players will run a DVD store by day and embody a ruthless assassin by night, with intense melee combat and tight gunplay. Get the rundown on the game's offerings with Blackwood, launching on September 16 for PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Risk of Rain 2 - Official Acolyte and Enforcer Survivors Reveal Trailer
recentItems.description: Meet two new survivors coming to Risk of Rain 2 in this latest trailer for the roguelike action game. The Acolyte is a close-range glaive-wielding Survivor who can wield powerful combos, but not without cost. The Enforcer is a defensive vanguard and a Survivor who combines powerful defense with dynamic, tactical movement. The Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts expansion will be available on Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S.

recentItems.title: Weed Out - Official Gameplay Trailer
recentItems.description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Weed Out, a bullet heaven roguelike developed by QuokkaPlay. Players will take on dangerous plants that have gone awry. Dispatch over 190 unique plant-based enemies, complete challenges, and dish out combos. Weed Out is coming soon to PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Foundlings - Official Demo Trailer
recentItems.description: Check out the latest Foundlings trailer for this upcoming RPG. Guide two troubled mages through a civil war-torn 12th-century England in this spellcasting RPG. Forge spells by combining conduits, trade favours with lords and serfs, watch the motions of the planets and keep your Humours in check as you help them find their purpose. Foundlings will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.

recentItems.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave - How to Recruit the Best Characters
recentItems.description:
No matter which of the four Flame Lords you choose when playing Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave, you’ll need to start recruiting more characters to your team as you progress in order to meet the increasingly challenging demands of each battle that you face. There are dozens of characters to meet in Dagsion that you can recruit, so it can be tricky to decide who to bring into the fold. We’re here to break down the basics of recruiting, as well as point you in the direction of some standout potential team mates to add to your team.

recentItems.title: The Resident Evil Movie Understands Video Games Are Ridiculous, and That's Why It's Great
recentItems.description:
Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie understands that video games are ridiculous, and that's why it's great.

Video games are ridiculous. The Resident Evil series is a perfect example. One moment you’re running in terror from a comically oversized, trench-coated tank of a man in a tiny hat; the next, you’re messing around with electronic chess pieces to open a door. These are completely alien situations that, somehow, these games compel us to navigate with rational thought. This is what Zach Cregger understands so well about Capcom’s genre-defining series. His Resident Evil movie knows this is ridiculous, so it lets its lead, Brian, progress through a 90-minute rollercoaster just as we would with a controller in our hands. It’s a fantastic translation of the sensation of playing a survival horror game, never forgetting to include every piece of glorious nonsense that comes with it.

recentItems.title: Dune: Awakening PS5 Pro - 24 Minutes of Single-Player Gameplay (Captured in 4K)
recentItems.description:
Take a look at **24 minutes of Dune: Awakening single-player gameplay** captured on **PS5 Pro in 4K Performance Mode**. See the dangerous world of Arrakis in action as we explore, fight, gather resources, and survive the harsh desert environment.
This gameplay footage gives you a closer look at how Dune: Awakening runs on PS5 Pro, including exploration, combat, traversal, crafting, and the game's massive open-world environments. **Dune: Awakening** is an open-world survival RPG set in the Dune universe, where surviving Arrakis is just as important as uncovering its secrets.

recentItems.title: How Golden Axe Adapts A Video Game Mythology No One Knows
recentItems.description: Sega's side-scrolling brawler may be a storied game franchise, but it's not exactly known for its story. Golden Axe showrunners Mike McMahan and Joe Chandler and stars Matthew Rhys, Liam McIntyre, Danny Pudi, and Carl Tart join IGN's Tom Jorgensen to explain how that was the perfect place to start building the show's mythology and how they incorporate video game logic into both the comedy and action. Matthew Rhys also reveals who he thinks his friend Conan O'Brien should play in Golden Axe Season 2.
